text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm proposing a small handshake change for /v1/generate: add optional `Accept-Model-Version` header that lets clients pin a model variant. Default behavior won't change (requests without header route to today's default). Plan: announce now, deprecate unpinned assumptions in 90 days. Need: SDK compatibility, telemetry hooks, and docs blurb. Thoughts?

ben: Quick Q — if header present but version missing, do we 404 or fall back? 404 will break some clients.

maria: Good call. Proposal: if header present and not found -> 400 with structured error `model_version_not_found` so clients can surface; if header absent -> no change. That preserves client opt-in.

toby: SDKs should expose a `pinModel(version)` helper and throw typed error on `model_version_not_found`. Also add a warning log. @sophie do we have bandwidth for doc snippets?

sophie: Yep; can draft a migration guide + snippet. We should also add an in-console banner and a short FAQ. Timeline ok: draft this week.

aj: Ops asks — add a telemetry flag: emit `x-model-version-exposed: <version|default>` in logs + a boolean `client_sent_model_version` for metrics. Also recommend adding `X-Deprecation-Warn` header in responses for 90 days at 30/14/7 day thresholds.

maria: Example curl and response header:

```bash
curl -H "Accept-Model-Version: rwd-1.2.3" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Response headers:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Model-Version: rwd-1.2.3
X-Deprecation-Warn: will-deprecate-unpinned-default in 90 days
```

maria: Action items: 1) eng-platform: implement header and 400 code (owner: ben) 2) SDK: pin helper + typed error (owner: toby) 3) docs: migration guide + banner (owner: sophie) 4) ops: telemetry + response header (owner: aj). I'll open PRs and ping reviewers. Anything else?

ben: fine, will sketch API change PR today. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Note: rolling deploys will include config toggle `accept_model_version` — start with canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

toby: Can we include a feature flag to log examples for 24h for safety? helps catch client regressions.

aj: yep — will add a temporary examples-log flag tied to environment.

maria: Great — merging plan. I'll post a comms draft to #announcements after PRs are green. Thanks all :rocket:
